skill.name: knowledge-work-human-resources
skill.description: Use when running people-operations work — recruiting, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation analysis, and policy guidance — standalone or connected to your HRIS and ATS.
whenToUse: Drafting an offer letter with compensation, start date, equity, and terms
Building an onboarding checklist and first-week plan for a new hire
Structuring a performance review with self-assessment prompts and calibration prep
Benchmarking compensation or modeling band placement and equity refreshes

keyConcepts.explanation: Commands are explicit slash workflows (/draft-offer, /onboarding, /performance-review, /policy-lookup, /comp-analysis, /people-report); skills are domain knowledge Claude applies automatically.
Tracks and manages the recruiting pipeline across source, screen, interview, and offer stages.
Benchmarks compensation against market data across base, equity, and total comp, backing the /comp-analysis command.
Answers questions about company policies, benefits, and procedures — PTO, expense, travel, remote work — behind /policy-lookup.
people-analytics analyzes attrition trends, engagement signals, and diversity metrics; org-planning handles headcount planning, org design, and team structure.
Creates structured interview plans — competency-based questions, scorecards, and debrief templates.

gotchas: Primarily designed for Cowork, Anthropic's agentic desktop app, though it also works in Claude Code
Commands run standalone but are supercharged only when you connect your HRIS, ATS, and other tools
It's a plugin bundling nine skills, not a single skill; skills fire automatically while commands are invoked explicitly
Compensation and people outputs are drafts to review, not authoritative HR, legal, or tax advice
/draft-offer needs role, level, location, and comp details before it produces a complete letter
